defs.def: an act of trying to do sth, especially sth difficult, often with no success 企图；试图；尝试

ex.s: Robert then decided to return to the fight, winning independence for the Scots — on the seventh attempt.
ex.t: 如果你传递的信息不紧急，可以考虑发送电子邮件。

ex.s: The annual arrival of the Saint Lukas is another attempt to improve the situation.
ex.t: 圣卢卡斯每年的到来是改善这一状况的又一次尝试。

ex.s: “Age is just another bot- her attempting to convince you of the impossible in the world, but actually the world is filled with possibilities,” she once said.
ex.t: “年龄不过是另一个试图让你相信世界上不可能的事的bot-her，但实际上世界充满可能，”她曾说。

ex.s: Today, there are about 2,000 or more grizzly bears in the US Their recovery has been so successful that the US Fish and Wildlife Service has twice attempted to delist grizzlies, which would loosen legal protections and allow them to be hunted.
ex.t: 如今，美国大约有2000只或更多的灰熊。它们的恢复如此成功，以至于美国鱼类和野生动物管理局曾两次试图将灰熊从保护名录中移除，这将放松法律保护并允许捕猎它们。

ex.s: I often leave early to seek the right destinations so I can set up early to avoid missing the moment I am attempting to photograph.
ex.t: 我经常早早出发去寻找合适的目的地，这样我可以提前架好设备，避免错过我想拍摄的瞬间。

ex.s: Still, she made no attempt to fly.
My childhood was all about the pursuits I had attempted most of which had been chosen by Mom.
ex.t: 我的童年全是关于我尝试过的那些追求，其中大多数都是妈妈替我选的。

ex.s: The field of artificial life-called ALife for short — is the systematic attempt to spell out life’s fundamental principles.
ex.t: 人工生命领域——简称ALife——是系统性地阐明生命基本原理的尝试。

ex.s: As much as many ALifers hate emphasizing their research’s applications, the attempts to create artificial life could have practical payoffs.
ex.t: 尽管许多ALife研究者不喜欢强调他们研究的实际应用，但创造人工生命的尝试可能会有实际的回报。

ex.s: Can Attempts to Create ALife Evolve, Too?
ex.t: 创造ALife的尝试也能进化吗？

ex.s: He didn’t attempt to walk back home; he waited and trusted.
ex.t: 他没有试图走回家；他等待着，信任着。

ex.s: Years of experience in the industry - and failed attempts to use technology - have convinced him that the best way to check cattle is with a man on a horse.
ex.t: 多年的行业经验——以及使用技术却失败的尝试——让他确信，检查牛群最好的方式是用一个骑在马上的人。

ex.s: Every year about 40,000 people attempt to climb Kilimanjaro, the highest mountain in Africa.
ex.t: 每年大约有40,000人尝试攀登乞力马扎罗山——非洲最高的山峰。

ex.s: These were attempts to damage Carson’s reputation and stop her work from influencing public policy, but she remained determined to stand by her research.
ex.t: 反复地/再次地，再次地/多次尝试时也一直失败。

defs.def: an act of trying to kill sb 杀人企图

ex.s: Instead of replying with a simple “OK, don’t rush”, I searched for emojis on my phone that would express the same message: (picture 2) This was my attempt to follow the trend of communicating with emojis.
ex.t: 而不是用简单的「OK，别急」来回答，我在手机上搜寻了表达相同讯息的emojis:(图2),

ex.s: You have forgotten an unfortunate person who attempted to kidnap you one night, this same person to whom you showed kindness when he was being punished.
ex.t: 毕竟，如果我们不照顾好我们的世界，它就不会持续很久。

ex.s: The 8th century: After six attempts, over a period of twelve years, Chinese monk Jianzhen arrived in Japan, where he promoted exchange and understanding between China and Japan.
ex.t: 反对意见如下/站在……一边。

ex.s: All of them represent attempts over the centuries to explore Earth’s furthest corners.
ex.t: 想想这在多大程度上是真实的。

defs.def: an effort to do better than sth, such as a very good performance in sport （为超越某事物的）尝试，努力
